body: -sessions N flag: runSession() loop, each session gets fresh UDP conn + botState, session ends on server disconnect or --session-duration elapsed; -session-duration flag (default 60s). myHealth float32 (0-100): decrements 0.5/tick when enemy <closeRange, regenerates 0.2/tick when no enemies. Retreat at hp<30: fwd=-1.0, aggressive strafe, no shooting, log 'retreating: hp=X'. hp field in serializeState for replay. receiveLoop closes state.done on exit. Build passes.
title: S42-03+S42-04: emily-bot self-play sessions + health-aware retreat
